subject: Tiered renewal procurement: PO lanes, staged acceptance, SOC2 evidence
messages:
From: David Kim <david.kim@redwood.com>
To: procurement@acmecorp.com, alice.ramirez@acmecorp.com
Cc: jonas.weber@redwood.com, karthik.iyer@redwood.com, marissa.cole@redwood.com
Date: 2026-10-03T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Tiered renewal procurement: PO lanes, staged acceptance, SOC2 evidence

Hi Alice / Acme procurement team —

Following our renewal conversation, summary and ask below:

Goal: Renew existing commitment and add a capacity uplift (20% seat-equivalent) with a 12-month term. Acme would like a split PO approach (initial operational PO + staged commit PO for the capacity uplift) to align to your quartered budget.

Proposed procurement flow:
- Submit initial PO for base renew (covers months 1–3) to get access updated in the portal.
- Staged PO (or PO amendment) to be raised after SOC2 evidence review; we can accept a second PO with a different billing cadence.
- Acceptance gates: basic provisioning (Day 0) + performance sanity checks (Day 7) + final signoff after evidence review (Day 30).

Attached: SOC2-excerpt.pdf (requested scope), proposed-PO-split.csv (example PO lanes), acceptance-criteria-v1.md.

Can procurement confirm: 1) if a split-PO flow is acceptable, 2) whether Acme requires a blanket SOW amendment or a single PO amendment model, and 3) any specific vendor onboarding checklist items still outstanding in your procurement portal (fields/attachments).

Jonas / Karthik / Marissa — tagging you for quick alignment if Acme requests contract-side changes or needs our portal access exceptions.

Thanks,
David

--
David Kim
Account Executive, Renewals
Redwood Inference
+1 415-555-0118
From: Alice Ramirez <alice.ramirez@acmecorp.com>
To: David Kim <david.kim@redwood.com>, procurement@acmecorp.com
Cc: tim.brody@acmecorp.com
Date: 2026-10-03T11:47:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Tiered renewal procurement: PO lanes, staged acceptance, SOC2 evidence

Hi David —

Thanks for the clear summary. Procurement confirms the split-PO approach is workable for Acme, provided the second PO references the original PO number and the SOW amendment is optional (we prefer PO amendments where possible). A couple of notes from our side: 

1) SOC2 evidence: the portal requires a redacted SOC2 report plus a short statement of scope. The SOC2-excerpt.pdf looks fine, but we need a one-paragraph statement confirming retention and logging behavior (30-day log retention minimum).

2) Onboarding checklist: our portal flags a vendor as "staged" until financial approval completes. Required portal fields we still need: vendor tax ID, primary invoice email, and the vendor contact phone. We can accept a temporary invoice email for the initial PO but final invoicing requires the canonical billing contact.

3) Tim (cc) will own billing cadence with finance; Tim, do you need the PO split in separate accounting buckets?

If you can provide the requested one-paragraph SOC2 statement and the vendor tax ID, we can move the initial PO through this week.

Best,
Alice Ramirez
Senior Procurement Manager
Acme Corp
From: David Kim <david.kim@redwood.com>
To: Alice Ramirez <alice.ramirez@acmecorp.com>, procurement@acmecorp.com
Cc: jonas.weber@redwood.com, karthik.iyer@redwood.com, marissa.cole@redwood.com
Date: 2026-10-04T08:23:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Tiered renewal procurement: PO lanes, staged acceptance, SOC2 evidence

Thanks Alice — quick answers inline and next steps: 

1) SOC2 statement: attached (SOC2-excerpt.pdf contains the excerpt; text below is the one-paragraph statement we can add to the portal and the PO):

"Redwood Inference confirms the SOC2 Type II report covers production inference services. Logs relevant to customer data operations are retained for a minimum of 30 days and archived per industry best practices. Customer access and audit logs are available on request under the agreed support channels."

2) Vendor tax ID (EIN): 27-9841123. Primary invoice email for initial PO: invoices+acme@redwood.com. Canonical billing contact for final invoicing: billing@redwood.com (we'll update after the initial PO).

3) PO split/accounting: Jonas — can you confirm we can provide a CSV with the suggested accounting buckets for Tim? I've attached proposed-PO-split.csv.

Jonas — Karthik: if Acme wants the SOW amendment instead, are there any legal hooks that would slow billing >7 days? If not, we should be able to proceed with the PO amendment flow.

Next steps I propose:
- David submits initial PO to portal with invoices+acme@redwood.com and vendor tax ID this morning.
- Acme stages the vendor and approves initial PO for provisioning.
- Redwood runs Day 7 performance sanity checks and shares the quick report.
- After evidence review, Acme submits second PO referencing the first PO number; final invoicing contact updated.

If that plan works I will upload the three attachments into the portal and push the initial PO.

Thanks —
David

Attachment: proposed-PO-split.csv

--
David Kim
Account Executive, Renewals
Redwood Inference
From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
To: David Kim <david.kim@redwood.com>, Alice Ramirez <alice.ramirez@acmecorp.com>, procurement@acmecorp.com
Cc: karthik.iyer@redwood.com, marissa.cole@redwood.com
Date: 2026-10-05T16:42:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Tiered renewal procurement: PO lanes, staged acceptance, SOC2 evidence

All —

Confirming we support the split-PO flow and that a PO amendment is preferred (no material legal delay expected). Quick notes from legal/finance: 

- PO amendment vs SOW amendment: PO amendment is cleaner for accounting; we can attach the acceptance-criteria-v1.md as an annex to the PO amendment.
- Billing buckets: we can provide the CSV mapping to Acme's 5-digit GL codes (David, I'll update proposed-PO-split.csv with the GLs and share a final file for Tim).
- Escrow/retention: if Acme needs an escrow clause, we'll surface standard language — likely a 30-day release window after final signoff.

Action items: 
- David: please upload the SOC2 paragraph and vendor tax ID to the portal and push the initial PO this afternoon.
- Alice / Tim: once initial PO is accepted, please add Acme's portal ticket ID to the HubSpot deal (link above) so CS can track provisioning.
- Karthik: if we need expedited countersignature for the PO amendment, loop legal and I'll prioritize.

I'll draft the PO amendment annex and send over before EOD tomorrow.

Thanks,
Jonas Weber
Director, Renewals Operations
Redwood Inference
